name: Haggedolim
title: Father of Zabdiel
summary: Haggedolim is a person mentioned in the book of Nehemiah as the father of Zabdiel, a leader among the priests in Jerusalem after the return from the Babylonian exile. He is known only through his son Zabdiel's role in rebuilding the Jewish community in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as the father of Zabdiel
keyEvents.description: Haggedolim is mentioned as the father of Zabdiel, who was the overseer of the priests in Jerusalem after the exile.

keyEvents.title: Settlement of the Priests in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: In connection with the repopulation of Jerusalem after the exile, Zabdiel, son of Haggedolim, was appointed as a leader among the priests who settled in the city.

keyEvents.title: Rebuilding the Religious Community
keyEvents.description: Haggedolim's family was part of the priestly lineage that helped restore worship in Jerusalem after returning from Babylon.

keyEvents.title: Service of the Priests in the Rebuilt Temple
keyEvents.description: As part of a priestly family, Haggedolim's descendants served in the rebuilt temple in Jerusalem under Nehemiah's leadership.
